analyst_view.overall: Early view: Valladolid are 11th under Fran Escribá and won 2-1 at Sporting on Sunday, their first away win of the season, though one preview listed Juanmi Latasa, Guille Bueno, De Rooij and Dani Pérez as injured. Real Sociedad B are 19th and were playing at Sabadell on Monday night. Iván Alejo's yellow-card ban should be served against Castellón on 14 November.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean higher: Valladolid's home games have averaged over four goals (5-0, 2-3 and 4-3 among them), and Real Sociedad B's away games average around three and a half.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners. Valladolid won six corners at Sporting with only 38% of the ball and should have more of it at home, so I see no reason to move from the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.2 cards. Valladolid were booked three times at Sporting and I found nothing unusual about Real Sociedad B's discipline, so I stay with the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.0 shots. Valladolid took 15 shots at Sporting even with little of the ball, and Real Sociedad B play open games, so a total around 30 is reasonable.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target. I lean slightly higher: Valladolid put six of 15 on target at Sporting, and their home matches have been high-scoring.
